activities.prompt: If you want to notice your feelings, what could you do?
activities.audioText: If you want to notice your feelings, what could you do?

options.text: 🌱 Take a moment and choose a word for yourself.
options.feedback: Choosing a word may help you notice how you feel.

options.text: 💬 Talk to a trusted adult if you want support.
options.feedback: Talking to a trusted adult for support is okay.

options.text: ⏸️ Ask for a pause if you do not want to answer.
options.feedback: It is okay to pause. You do not have to answer.

activities.feedback: You can feel different ways. You may ask for help or pause.
activities.teacherNotes: Generic draft; do not ask the child to share a feeling or infer one. Review wording and local suitability before use.
